implementation.procedure: Replay actual validation CLI default/context mode and full hash-bound restoration.
implementation.acceptance: Full observed inspection tree is restored; default CLI/exit code stay unchanged; only two provenance maps are externalized.

reference_boundary.procedure: Check guide-root rebasing, cross-project copies, unknown display fields, modified records and unchanged status/errors/scope/limitations.
reference_boundary.acceptance: Unsafe paths/roots/projects/unknown fields/modified records refuse. Display and restoration do not grant acceptance; full original values remain recoverable.

data_integrity.procedure: Bind frozen source/input/config files and two raw successful native turn logs.
data_integrity.acceptance: Provider final input+output accounting is valid and exactly two distinct fresh no-tool turns; no retries or fabricated usage.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Compare provider total tokens and independent pending-block/status/errors/action/scope oracle.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Both exact oracle answers pass and candidate total input+output is lower; caches are not subtracted.

measurement_validity.procedure: Compare all actual non-task rollout plaintext, tool catalogs, thread policies and model/schema/question; observation is frozen, not scientific acceptance.
measurement_validity.acceptance: Same native server/binary/config/model/high effort/project roots, profiles and every non-task instruction byte; only recoverable display JSON differs. Quota before each, first<=25000, paired<=50000, two calls, zero retries, 90s per turn.

reproducibility.procedure: Independent host process replays sources/fixtures/accounting and necessary tests without inference.
reproducibility.acceptance: Six-domain plan is frozen before dispatch, actual CLI display/exit and full restoration agree, separate verification node gates publication; no long-document or cash claim.

scope: one short reading of an actual pending validation observation; only recoverable display representation changes

errors: trusted host verifier unavailable; worker pass JSON is not acceptance
oracle.scope: one short synthetic six-claim handoff on identical fresh native threads; only lossless wire claim encoding changes

success_requires: all actual non-task plaintext and tool catalog hashes match
full restoration and independent source/quality validation pass
